--disable-dependency-detection.Name: --disable-dependency-detection
--disable-dependency-detection.description: Disable "smart" file inclusion. By default, Zapier only includes files that are required by `index.js`. If you (or your dependencies) require files dynamically (such as with `require(someVar)`), then you may see "Cannot find module" errors. Disabling this may make your `build.zip` too large. If that's the case, try using the `includeInBuild` option in your `.zapierapprc`. See the docs about `includeInBuild` for more info
